description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on Zhipu GLM-5.3, frontier reasoning with tool calling and a 1M-token context. Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/glm5 and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $2.8 per million input and $8.8 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.2342. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (tool calling, reasoning, streaming supported), up to 8192 output tokens. Costs $0.2342 USDC per call (x402).
